(begin (dialog '(("/" "Nobody knows what the writing on this stone means, it is not even known who wrote it."))) (define id "029-tree-story") (if (get id) (dialog '(("/" "Do you want to hear the legend of this tree again?"))) (dialog '(("/" "Are you interested to learn about the legend of this tree?")))) (answer id '(("Yes please" . #t) ("No thanks" . #f))) (wait) (if (get id) (dialog '(("/" "There was once a devastating war in this area and everything was razed to the ground.
Nothing and no one remained, except this tree.
It is said that this tree encloses all the souls who left us.
It has the particularity of withering in spring and blooming in the other seasons.
Every spring the souls leave this tree to make other plants bloom and then, at the end of spring, the souls return to flourish again this tree.
That's all I know about this tree.
I hope to have time to see the end of this winter season which has persisted for more than 60 years now."))) (dialog '(("/" "Ok, it was a long and boring story after all.")))))
